title: PaceVector deck brief
description: One deck: a cover plus 4 or 6 body slides (5 or 7 slides in total, deck-rules.md). Copy is rendered exactly as written; the renderer sizes and places it but never rewrites it. Every colour and size comes from design/01-tokens/tokens.json. Posting history is read from brands/<brand>/memory/posted.jsonl (row shape under $defs.postedRow).

deckId.description: Deck key. Output lands in out/<deckId>/.

series.description: Series label as it appears in the slide header, uppercase mono, e.g. "RUNNING 101" (series.md).

date.description: Planned post date (ISO). Anchors the 90-day perceptual-hash window and is written to the posted row. Defaults to today.

handle.description: Handle shown on the cta slide. Defaults to @PACEVECTOR.

slides.description: Slides 2..N in order. Slide 2 must be a stat or a question that stands alone; the last must be cta; the same component never runs three in a row.

subject.description: Cover family. Mix per rolling 20 posts is 14/3/2/1 and is enforced from posted.jsonl.

ground.description: Cover ground. Omit to take the ground the alternation requires; when given it is checked against the last post (deep counts as navy).

mode.description: Headline mode (cover-grammar). Never the same mode three posts running.

kicker.description: Top-left mono kicker, six words max, separator · never an em dash. In number mode this is the unit line.

headline.description: The headline copy. Shout: one or two words (rendered uppercase). Sentence: five to nine words. Number: a single figure.

lines.description: Explicit line breaks. When omitted: shout breaks one word per line, sentence breaks greedily at the fitted size, number is one line. The concatenation must equal the headline.

align.description: Headline alignment within the 888 measure. Default left; number mode defaults to centre.

aside.description: Optional one-line aside under the headline, IBM Plex Sans 300 italic at lead.

payoff.description: Type-led covers only: a short Sora 700 line near the bottom of the safe area (e.g. "You go anyway."). Steps down from subtitle to fit.

signal.description: The single signal element, or none. chip: kicker chip (either ground). type: kicker in signal (navy only). block: fill block under the last headline line with ink type (white only). mark: the tick on the markedKm device (conceptual only).

figure.description: full-figure and detail covers. Name a cutout or give hints; the renderer picks the first eligible cutout by energy/faces match, skipping ids used in the last 5 posts and grounds the manifest excludes.

mirror.description: Flip horizontally. Default: face into the headline.

x.description: Explicit left edge in slide px. Needs y.

y.description: Explicit top edge in slide px.

scale.description: Never above 1: a cutout is never enlarged beyond native size.

slicedEdges.description: Override of which image edges are sliced crop edges and must sit on or beyond the canvas edge. Default: manifest crop wording plus alpha detection.

headlineTop.description: Pin the top of the first headline line (slide px). Default: searched.

graphicTop.description: Conceptual covers: top of the device graphic.

front.description: Indices of headline lines drawn in front of the figure. Default: all lines behind, moving only failing lines in front (grammar fix order).

device.description: type-led: plain | rule-cut | scale-break | hairline-stack (03-covers/cover-type-led). conceptual: paceLine | splitRuler | markedKm | threeZones | effortCurve | effortDots (03-covers/cover-concept).

at.description: markedKm: tick position as a fraction of the line.

filled.description: effortDots: filled dots out of ten.

stopTest.description: The content engine's stop-test score for this cover. Below 4 blocks the deck.

source.description: One row per figure shown on a slide (sources.md: figure - exact quote or table cell - url - publisher - retrieved date - cross-checked).

richText.description: Plain text. One [[phrase]] may be wrapped to set it in accent-ink (at most one accent per slide); \n forces a line break.

label.description: Mono kicker above the value, e.g. "01 · EASY MEANS EASY".

valueStep.description: Size step for the value. xl by default; l for wide values (template third state).

items.description: Stacked pair variant: two numbered points in one frame.

ground.description: Third state: statement on the accent ground with an arrow rule; label and aside are not shown.

fill.description: Accent range as percentages of the bar.

ticks.description: Bar: mono tick labels spread across the bar, tone lifts one out of mute. Ruler variant: the number of ticks.

variant.description: Tick-ruler variant (template third state): a plain ruler with n ticks and a mono caption.

points.description: Single accent curve: [x, y] pairs normalised 0..1 (y up).

reference.description: One dashed reference line with an annotated point.

cutout.description: Cutout id; drawn at most at native size in the light-tint panel.

ask.description: One or two lines: save/follow prompt or a question.

credit.description: One line of source credit (deck-rules: last slide carries one line of source credit).

postedRow.description: One line of brands/<brand>/memory/posted.jsonl, appended by the publish step from out/<deckId>/deck.json postedRow. The renderer reads: ground (alternation), subject (14/3/2/1 mix over 20), mode (no run of three), cutout (no repeat within 5), position (no repeat within 5), date + coverHash (90-day perceptual hash).

coverHash.description: 16 hex chars, 64-bit DCT perceptual hash of 01.jpg.
